node.title: KoalaBear m4 S6 (5,6,2) pair-quotient normal form
node.closure: exact cubic-adjoint normalization of the unordered-pair curve plus challenge-field pole descent
node.statement: The rigid passport S6:5.1,2.2.2,3.2.1 has an explicit rational degree-15 normal form obtained from the cubic-adjoint pencil on the unordered-pair curve of the pinned BelyiDB degree-six companion. Its fibers are (5,5,5), (6,3,3,2,1), and (2,2,2,2,2,2,1,1,1). Its order-five fiber has one rational point and two points over Q(sqrt(5)), so the required three-point pole divisor splits over F_(2130706433^6). No split active fiber, quartic source-star incidence, m4 deletion, owner charge, endpoint, or row close is claimed.
